image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a bagel topped with sesame seeds. The bagel has a distinct toroidal shape with a central hole. The crust appears pale golden to light brown, textured with numerous small, toasted sesame seeds. The surface shows slight irregularities and blistering typical of baked dough. In the background, out-of-focus portions of other bagels are visible, suggesting a batch or display setting.
